# Requirement card

- id: SR-NNN · parent: R? · module: M? · priority: must/should/could
- text: The <system/module> shall <action> <object> <measurable criterion> [under <conditions>].
- rationale:
- verification: Test / Analysis / Inspection / Demonstration
- acceptance: (numeric with unit and tolerance; or TBD (measure in <test>))
- standard: (clause, if any)
- verified_by: (test IDs / report files)
Quality check: singular · verifiable · feasible · unambiguous (no fast/robust/etc./and-or) · solution-free unless constraint
